## Problem

What risky pattern or gap is not covered today.

## Proposed check or change

Describe the detection logic, the severity you would expect, and the evidence the report should show.

## Example

A launch configuration or tool description that should trigger the new behaviour. Use fixtures, not real third-party servers.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approach you evaluated, and why this one is preferable.
